name: Connect with Emblem.gr
author: tsirosgeorge

sections.description:
Connect with Emblem.gr is the official WooCommerce integration for businesses using Emblem.gr.

The plugin allows store owners to issue invoices directly from WooCommerce orders without leaving the WordPress administration panel. Orders are securely transmitted to your Emblem account where the invoice is created and immediately available as a printable PDF.

Designed for Greek businesses, the plugin supports electronic invoicing workflows, myDATA integration through Emblem, and WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Main Features

  • One-click invoice issuance directly from WooCommerce Orders
  • Automatic PDF generation and instant preview
  • Full WooCommerce order synchronization
  • Invoice history inside WordPress
  • Credit note issuance
  • Invoice re-submission to Eskap provider
  • Support for multiple invoice document types
  • Retail and Wholesale transaction modes
  • Secure authentication using your Emblem account
  • HPOS compatible
  • Modern WordPress interface
  • Automatic status updates
  • Order notes for every invoice action

Invoice Types

The plugin supports multiple document types, including:

  • Retail Sales Receipt
  • Retail Sales Receipt with Delivery Note
  • Sales Invoice
  • Sales Invoice with Delivery Note
  • Service Invoice
  • Retail Service Receipt
  • myDATA Retail Receipt

Additional document types may become available depending on your Emblem configuration.

Invoice Management

Every issued document is stored inside the plugin.

You can:

  • View issued invoices
  • Search invoices
  • Filter by document type
  • Open the generated PDF
  • View MARK and UID values
  • Check myDATA transmission status
  • Create credit notes
  • Re-send invoices when necessary

WooCommerce Integration

The plugin adds a dedicated Emblem Invoice column to the WooCommerce Orders page.

Depending on the order status, administrators can:

  • Issue a new invoice
  • Open the generated PDF
  • Re-send an existing invoice
  • View document information

Everything happens without leaving the Orders screen.

Remote Connection

The plugin communicates securely with your Emblem account using your Email and Password.

Before using the plugin you can verify the connection using the built-in Check Connection tool.

Why Connect with Emblem.gr?

  • Save time by eliminating manual invoice entry
  • Reduce invoicing errors
  • Keep WooCommerce synchronized with Emblem
  • Generate invoices with one click
  • Simplify electronic invoicing workflows
  • Print invoices instantly

External Services

This plugin connects to the Emblem.gr cloud services.

Information is transmitted only when required by the user, such as:

  • Creating invoices
  • Printing invoices
  • Synchronizing invoice information
  • Checking account credentials
  • Retrieving invoice PDFs

Data transmitted may include:

  • Order information
  • Customer details
  • Order items
  • Shipping information
  • Invoice settings
  • User authentication credentials

Service Provider:

https://emblem.gr

Privacy Policy:

https://emblem.gr/wp/policy.html

Terms of Service:

https://emblem.gr/wp/policy.html

Privacy

The plugin communicates with Emblem cloud services only when requested by an administrator.

No data is transmitted unless an invoice, synchronization, or connection verification is performed.

Support

https://emblem.gr

Support:

info@emblem.gr

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the ZIP file manually.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Emblem Invoice.
  4. Enter your Emblem account Email and Password.
  5. Click Check Connection to verify your credentials.
  6. Select your preferred transaction type.
  7. Choose the default invoice document type.
  8. Save your settings.
  9. Open WooCommerce → Orders and start issuing invoices.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Emblem account?

Yes. A valid Emblem account is required.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Can I print invoices?

Yes. Every issued invoice can be opened as a PDF directly from WooCommerce.

Can I create credit notes?

Yes. Credit notes can be issued directly from the plugin.

Does the plugin support myDATA?

Yes. Documents issued through Emblem can be transmitted to myDATA according to your Emblem configuration.

Can I resend an invoice?

Yes. Existing invoices can be re-submitted without generating a new document.

Where are the plugin settings?

WooCommerce → Emblem Invoice.
